Completion evidence (all codebase-verified; landed in Gerrit change 1969 -> origin/main 695cab7b0c):

AC1 (every core _dispatch_* routes through a Route.parser_factory; no parallel imperative grammar; metrics excluded): src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/ adds 14 family modules with one build_<name>(*, prog) factory per command; _registry.py wires parser_factory onto all 49 core Routes; handlers parse through the factory. In-tree oracle tests/unit/test_core_cli_parsers.py registry-completeness test asserts the exact 49-name core set each carries a parser_factory. metrics untouched (S2c). resolve_accepted removed (0 refs in src/).

AC2 (accepted/rejected argv matrices: missing/surplus values, space/equal options, --, global output extraction, per-family unknown-token skip vs reject-exit-2, malformed input): held-out parity oracle (49 commands x 9-variant battery incl --help, -h, --nonexistent-flag-xyz, empty, surplus-args, --output bogus, --output=bogus, --, and bare dash) GREEN 49/49; 7 structural checks GREEN; total 56/56 byte-exact vs pre-migration golden.

AC3 (persisted effects, no-effect refusals, diagnostics, streams, exit codes: no unapproved delta via real production-path tests): held-out parity captures real subprocess stdout/stderr/exit per variant; existing interface suites (tests/interfaces/facades + lifecycle exit-code conformance) 817 passed; full CI suite green on PS2 (run 32427234163), all 3 ubuntu + macos pytest jobs.

AC4 (parser construction imports no domain executor/optional dep; selected execution resolves no unrelated factory/handler; construction-exclusion probe + dispatch-isolation assertion): in-tree oracle includes 5 dispatch-isolation spy tests + a construction-exclusion poison-probe; 70/70 pass.

AC5 (module-size/complexity policy; each family revertable as one unit): largest touched file composer.py 782 LOC (<800 cap); module-size gate green in CI; complexity ratchet regenerated shrink-only (--update-stale: active=49 new=0 increased=0 stale=0), test_complexity_baseline green on PS2; each family = its parser module + one _registry.py wiring line + its _dispatch_* switch (self-contained hunk, no cross-family coupling).
